title: Tangut Word Segmentation under Extreme Resource Scarcity: Integrating Traditional Lexicons and Unlabeled Text
abstract: arXiv:2608.18437v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tangut is an extinct language whose script does not explicitly mark word boundaries. We present the first systematic study of Tangut word segmentation using 2,750 expert-annotated segments(31,893 tokens), traditional lexicons, and unlabeled text. Our framework combines a reliability-calibrated lexicon-lattice representation, explicit distributional statistics, and a lightweight character encoder pretrained with MLM. Segment-level five-fold cross-validation shows that lexical and statistical features raise CRF F1 to approximately 0.91. The full TangutEncoder reaches the highest mean F1 (0.911) and improves recall beyond the labeled training vocabulary. These results demonstrate generalization beyond the limited supervised vocabulary across thematically diverse held-out passages, while document-level transfer remains to be evaluated.

translated_title: 极端资源稀缺下的西夏文分词：融合传统词典与未标注文本
translated_abstract: 西夏文是一种已消亡的语言，其文字不明确标示词边界。我们首次对西夏文分词进行了系统性研究，使用了2,750个专家标注片段（共31,893个词元）、传统词典和未标注文本。我们的框架结合了可靠性校准的词典格表示、显式分布统计以及通过掩码语言模型预训练的轻量级字符编码器。段落级五折交叉验证显示，词汇和统计特征将条件随机场的F1分数提升至约0.91。完整的西夏编码器达到了最高的平均F1分数（0.911），并提高了超出标注训练词汇的召回率。这些结果表明，在主题多样的保留段落中，模型超越了有限监督词汇的泛化能力，而文档级迁移仍有待评估。
tldr: 该研究首次系统性地解决了西夏文分词问题，通过融合传统词典、分布统计和预训练字符编码器，在极少量标注数据下实现了高F1分数（0.911），并展示了跨主题的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This study presents the first systematic approach to Tangut word segmentation, integrating traditional lexicons, distributional statistics, and a pretrained character encoder to achieve high F1 (0.911) under extreme resource scarcity, demonstrating generalization across diverse themes.
